title: gen_sprites.py docstring documents the sprite output in the pre-fix (drifted) order, contradicting SPRITE_ORDER in the same file
evidence:
+Output: assets/sprites/{house_0..3, host, dc, small_biz, campus, puck_1..3}.png
...
+SPRITE_ORDER = [
+    "house_0", "house_1", "house_2", "house_3", "host", "dc",
+    "puck_1", "puck_2", "puck_3", "small_biz", "campus",
+]
detail: The module docstring lists small_biz/campus BEFORE the pucks — exactly the B1 drift this PR exists to fix — while SPRITE_ORDER, 60 lines below, pins pucks before the terminals. Same file, two orders.
recommended_fix: Reorder the docstring line to '{house_0..3, host, dc, puck_1..3, small_biz, campus}.png' to match SPRITE_ORDER; better, derive the docstring wording from the constant.

title: README 'Export names (pinned by sprites.odin)' section lists names in an order that contradicts the pinned order
evidence:
+## Export names (pinned by app/render/sprites.odin — 11 files)
+
+`house_0..3.png`, `host.png`, `dc.png`, `small_biz.png`, `campus.png`,
+`puck_1..3.png` — land in `../sprites/`.
detail: Under a header claiming the names are pinned, the README lists small_biz/campus before the pucks; SPRITE_ORDER and spec §2 ('house_0..3, host, dc, puck_1..3, small_biz, campus') put pucks first. Invites hand-export drift.
recommended_fix: List the names in the pinned order (puck_1..3 before small_biz, campus) or explicitly state the list is unordered and point to the authoritative order.

title: Tilt labels inverted: new docs call 67° 'shallowest' while the deleted code comment called ~66° 'steep'
evidence:
-    # orthographic, the MM top-down tilt: steep (~66 deg) — the roof reads AND
...
+| Camera | ORTHO, tilt ~49–67° — varies with the per-sprite pad (campus steepest ≈49°, pucks shallowest ≈67°; measured from bbox projections); the roof carries the read, thin outline visible all around | the MM top-down view (7.1 canon) |
detail: Under the elevation convention the old comment used (~66° = steep top-down), 67° is the steep end, not 'shallowest'. The inverted labels are repeated in four places (spec, README, docstring, PR body).
recommended_fix: Swap the labels (pucks ≈67° steepest, campus ≈49° shallowest) or state the angle convention explicitly; then re-check all four copies.
